full_judgment: Mohammad Abdur Rouf, J: The petitioner an ex-process server Rajshahi Collect orate, was dismissed from service on 11.5.91, uncle Rule, 4(3)(d) of the Government Servants (Discipline and Appeal Rules 1985, hereinafter referred to as "the Rules", with effect from 5.8.90. on the ground of misconduct and desertion, contemplated n Rules 3(b) and 3(c) of the sat Rules. The petitioner's appeal, preferred under Rule 17 thereof, to the appellate authority i.e the Divisional Commissioner, Rajshahi, was dismissed on 28.3.92. Thereafter on 25.7.93 he filed Administrative Tribunal Case No. 79 of 1993, and Section 4(1) of the Administrative Tribunal Act. 1980, hereinafter referred to as "the Act", for a declaration that the order of dismissal from his service is illegal, void in-operative and that he is still in service". The Administrative Tribunal on 4.9.93 dismissed the case holding, inter alia, that the same was barred by limitation having not been filed within 6 months from the decision given on 28.3.92 by the administrative appellate authority. Being aggrieved thereby the petitioner preferred Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal No. 110 of 1993 against the said judgment and order of the Administrative Tribunal. By the impugned judgment and order dated 26.7.94 the Administrative Appellate Tribunal dismissed the appeal upholding the judgment and order appealed, against. The petitioner is now seeking leave to appeal from the said judgment of the aforesaid Appellate Tribunal.
